findings.evidence: Superfluous.lean:231-239 mentions no ring-specific or group-specific operation; `Submodule R M` is a `CompleteLattice` and `IsCoatom` is available for `[Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]`. ProjectiveCover.lean:190-192 is `hf.isSuperfluous_ker.le_jacobson`, which involves `P` alone.
findings.fix: Move `IsSuperfluous.le_coatom` above `end Semiring` so it holds with `[Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M]`; state `ker_le_jacobson` with `M` only an `AddCommMonoid` (e.g. a separate variable block, keeping `[Ring R] [AddCommGroup P]`).
findings.issue: `IsSuperfluous.le_coatom` is in the `Ring` section (`[Ring R] [AddCommGroup M]`, line 219) but its proof uses only the lattice structure of `Submodule R M` (`hm.1`, `hm.2`, `le_sup_left/right`, `eq_top_of_sup_eq_top`); `Module.jacobson` never appears. Same problem at `TauCeti/Algebra/Module/ProjectiveCover.lean:190`, where `IsProjectiveCover.ker_le_jacobson` inherits `[AddCommGroup M]` from the section though the statement `LinearMap.ker f ≤ Module.jacobson R P` only constrains `P`; `[AddCommMonoid M]` suffices.

findings.evidence: Every Mathlib lemma these proofs use is already semilinear with `[RingHomSurjective τ₁₂]`: `Submodule.comap_map_sup_of_comap_le` and `comap_map_eq` (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Span/Basic.lean:534-557), `Submodule.map_comap_eq_of_surjective` (Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Submodule/Map.lean:300), `Submodule.map_symm_eq_iff` (ibid.:577); cf. `Module.le_comap_jacobson` (Mathlib/RingTheory/Jacobson/Radical.lean:39-48).
findings.fix: State them for `{R₂} [Semiring R₂] {τ₁₂ : R →+* R₂} [RingHomSurjective τ₁₂] (f : M →ₛₗ[τ₁₂] M₂)` (resp. `e : M ≃ₛₗ[τ₁₂] M₂`); the proofs go through unchanged.
findings.issue: `IsSuperfluous.map` (140), `isSuperfluous_map_equiv_iff` (158) and `IsSuperfluous.comap` (166) are restricted to `M →ₗ[R] M₂` / `M ≃ₗ[R] M₂`, stronger than the Mathlib convention for `Submodule.map`/`comap` transport — including the directly parallel radical lemmas `Module.le_comap_jacobson` / `Module.map_jacobson_le`, which are semilinear.

findings.evidence: ProjectiveCover.lean:129-130: `Module.projective_lifting_property f g hf.surjective` needs `[Projective R Q]` (Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Projective.lean:111-113 shows the projective argument is the source of `g`), and the second component only uses `hf.isSuperfluous_ker`.
findings.fix: State the general version (`hf : Function.Surjective f`, `hker : IsSuperfluous (LinearMap.ker f)` — or as an `IsSuperfluous.…` lemma next to `surjective_of_surjective_comp`) and derive the cover form from `hf.surjective`/`hf.isSuperfluous_ker`.
findings.issue: `IsProjectiveCover.exists_surjective` assumes `hf : IsProjectiveCover f` but never uses `hf.projective`: the lift comes from `[Module.Projective R Q]` and surjectivity of the lift from `hf.isSuperfluous_ker`. The result holds for any surjection with superfluous kernel, so it is stated one level below the general form.

summary: The mathematical content is at the right level, but three declarations carry assumptions they do not use: a purely lattice-theoretic lemma sits in the `Ring`/`AddCommGroup` section, the map/comap transport lemmas are stated only for linear (not semilinear) maps unlike every Mathlib lemma they are built from, and `exists_surjective` never uses projectivity of the cover's source.
